## Spruit Sunrise — Poly Haven
Author: Greg Zaal. Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/spruit_sunrise . License: CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Local file: public/assets/environment/spruit_sunrise_1k.hdr . Official MD5 101e62113705da89b6fa2299385ce801 verified. Used for environment illumination, not a copied game scene.

## Mossy Rock — Poly Haven
Author: Rob Tuytel. Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock . License: CC0 1.0 https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . Local normal and roughness maps: public/assets/surfaces/mossy-rock-*.jpg. Official MD5s verified; SHA-256 and byte records in public/assets/v5-source-hashes.json. Used for rock/terrain micro-surface while preserving original geometry and palette.

## VSCO 2 Community Edition instrument recordings
Recorded by Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler / Soundemote.
Official source: https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
License: CC0 1.0. Full accompanying license: assets/audio/VSCO-CC0.txt.
Seven locally processed mono instrument samples. Provenance, original Git blob hashes,
processed SHA-256 hashes and transformations: assets/audio/sources.json.
The original Spring Letter composition is distinct from the source recordings.

## Rocky Trail and White Plaster 02 colour — Poly Haven
Rocky Trail by Amal Kumar: https://polyhaven.com/a/rocky_trail
White Plaster 02 by Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/white_plaster_02
License: CC0 1.0. Full text: assets/v7/CC0-1.0.txt.
Four 1K image maps; per-file source, hashes and authors: assets/v7/source.json.

## v8 recorded footsteps and natural ambience
Kenney — Impact Sounds 1.0: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
Three grass and three concrete footsteps; one mining impact excerpt. Concrete
recordings represent the game's hard stone paths. The mining excerpt represents
short stone-tile contact, not a literal recording of a rotating tile.
isaiah658 — Ambient Bird Sounds: https://opengameart.org/content/ambient-bird-sounds
Thimras (Eike Germann) — Park ambiences, river recording:
https://opengameart.org/content/park-ambiences
All three original author pages explicitly offer CC0 1.0 Universal.
Full license text: assets/foley-v8/CC0-1.0.txt
Original package notice: assets/foley-v8/Kenney-License.txt
Nine mono 22,050 Hz PCM16 WAV derivatives, including two 20-second ambient loops.
Source URLs, original/processed SHA-256, trimming, crossfade and measured levels:
assets/foley-v8/sources.json. Authorship and use notes: assets/foley-v8/README.md.
